headline: Preprint reports elastic expert parallelism for more efficient MoE reinforcement-learning rollouts
summary: A preprint describes FlexFloor, which jointly plans prompt placement and progressively shrinks the active expert-parallel group during synchronous mixture-of-experts reinforcement-learning rollouts. In one setup using Qwen3-30B-A3B on 16 Ascend devices with vLLM 0.14.1, the authors report 52.74% higher rollout throughput and roughly 65.4% higher response-token work per occupied rank-second than the verl baseline. The paper gives a detailed accounting protocol, including rank detach and restoration intervals, but its performance results remain author-reported. A one-seed, short held-out evaluation and one frozen-policy code workload do not establish long-run quality equivalence or general transfer.
